newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mahathir to launch KLIH's electric park.
newsitem.headline: Mahathir to launch KLIH's electric park.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad will launch an industrial park dedicated to producing locally-made home appliances on March 17, said a statement by Malaysia Electric Corp Bhd (MEC) on Tuesday.
The four-billion ringgit project called MEC City is being billed as the country's "electrical appliances capital" with products to be sold domestically and abroad, the statement said.
The project, a branchild of Mahathir, is part of government efforts to reduce the trade deficit by reducing imports and increasing exports.
Malaysia's electrical appliances market is currently dominated by Japanese and South Korean products.

MEC, a wholly-owned unit of property and manufacturing firm Kuala Lumpur Industries Holdings Bhd (KLIH), was identified to lead the effort. Previously called Superior Products Inc, MEC has been producing electrical appliances for the last 20 years, the statement said.
MEC City is sited on 1,200 hectares of land near Kuantan city on the east coast with the entire project due to be developed in 10 years.
MEC will eventually produce products like rice cookers, kettles, televisions, air-conditioners and refrigerators under the MEC brand.
